items.title: Tolliver interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: I mean today’s it’s just one of the greatest works of all time. It will last forever.

ctx.x: If you felt that you weren’t reaching the bulk of the audience, were there things that you worked on adjusting?

No. Because my thing is to assemble the very best at this, you know — whatever the event is, the venue — musicians. And this is from as a child and as a teenager watching because I got a chance to see just about everybody you know, just about everybody who was still alive when I broke in. And to the man, they never peopled their bands with anything less than just super musicians. And so that stuck with me and so when I come onstage with a unit it’s absolutely crack. And so between starting and ending you know,…

Okay. I wonder if you have ever attended a concert, let’s say someone like Albert Ayler who was on the far end of where things could go, and witnessed a reaction like the audience at the premier of “The Rite of Spring”?
